newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Umax 1996 sales up 72.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Umax 1996 sales up 72.64 pct.

text.p: Taiwan manufacturer Umax Data Systems Inc said on Thursday its 1996 sales revenue soared 72.64 percent to T$6.3 billion from 1995's T$3.649 billion.
In December alone, Umax posted sales revenues of T$925 million, up 116.97 percent from T$426 million in December 1995, the firm said in a statement. It gave no profit figures.
Umax hoped its 1997 sales would exceed T$10 billion, the statement said.
The company expects its image scanners -- its main product -- to maintain a 40 percent growth in 1997 on rising global demand.
It also expects its new products -- computers based on Apple Computer Inc's Macintosh series -- to enjoy good growth in 1997, the statement said.
Umax and its U.S. unit Umax Computer Corp are among several Asian manufacturers licensed to design and make Mac-compatible "clones" that run on Apple's popular Mac OS operating system.
